title: The Ravaged Caravan and the Venture Co.

segments.t: Accept The Ravaged Caravan from Morin Cloudstalker
Turn in The Ravaged Caravan

tips.text: The Ravaged Caravan is north-east of Bloodhoof. Read the Sealed Supply Crate there to pick up the next part.

segments.t: Accept The Ravaged Caravan from Sealed Supply Crate
Turn in The Ravaged Caravan to Morin Cloudstalker
Accept The Venture Co. from Morin Cloudstalker
Accept Supervisor Fizsprocket from Morin Cloudstalker

professionHooks.note: Kill Venture Co. Hireling (Mulgore, lvl 5-6): the recipe Recipe: Minor Mageblood Elixir drops here. Forever-new; Venture Co. Hireling (zone per the quest database) also Young Wendigo (Alliance zone).

sources.label: Hardcore Helper WoW Forever zone guide

tips.text: Malah Longwind is east of Bloodhoof near the zone edge.

sources.label: Hardcore Helper WoW Forever zone guide

segments.t: Kill the Windfury for Dangers of the Windfury at 59.5, 71.2 before you ride north to the Venture Co. mine.

tips.text: Windfury harpies are south-east of Bloodhoof Village. Wind Witches cast from range; close the gap or kill them first.

professionHooks.note: Kill Windfury Wind Witch (Mulgore, lvl 8-9): the recipe Recipe: Minor Frenzy Potion drops here. Forever-new; also from Bloodfeather Harpy (Alliance zone) and Hatescreech.

segments.t: Complete The Venture Co.

tips.text: The Venture Co. camp is in the north-east of Mulgore. Do The Venture Co. and Supervisor Fizsprocket in one visit.

segments.t: Complete Supervisor Fizsprocket

tips.text: Supervisor Fizsprocket is at the top of the Venture Co. mine area. Clear the workers around him first.

segments.t: Accept Fizsprocket's Notes

tips.text: Fizsprocket drops Mulgore Expansion Plans, which starts this Forever quest. The missing pages are inside the same mine.

segments.t: Complete Fizsprocket's Notes
Complete Thunderhorn Totem
Keep the cougar femur, swoop gizzard, and plainstrider scale at 48.7, 50.9. Get the Prairie Wolf Heart from a Prairie Wolf Alpha around 45.56, 35.4.

tips.text: Mazzranache needs one part each from a prairie wolf, a flatland cougar, a plainstrider and a swoop. They all drop from beasts you kill for other quests, so just loot as you go.
